description: Advanced crafting system: multi-step recipes, tool upgrading, and resource refinement. Extends the existing cooking/recipe system with workbench-based crafting that produces tools, building materials, and upgraded items.
steps: Add new crafting items to packages/shared/src/items.ts ItemId union: 'iron_ingot', 'plank', 'cloth', 'stone_axe', 'iron_axe', 'stone_pickaxe', 'iron_pickaxe', 'workbench'. Add ITEM_DEFINITIONS entries. Mark workbench as placeableStructure with structureCollidable: false.

Add prices for new items in packages/shared/src/economy.ts. Iron ingot/plank/cloth are intermediate materials (cheap buy, lower sell). Tools cost 50-100+ coins but crafting them from raw materials is cheaper.

Create packages/game-engine/src/crafting/craftingDefinitions.ts defining: CraftingStation enum (hand, workbench), CraftingRecipe (id, station, ingredients[], resultItemId, resultQuantity, craftTimeMs, titleKey), ToolTier (stone, iron), ToolBonus (defines harvest speed multiplier per tier). Define 8+ recipes: ore->iron_ingot (workbench), wood->plank (hand), fiber->cloth (hand), plank+iron_ingot->workbench (hand), stone+wood->stone_axe (hand), iron_ingot+plank->iron_axe (workbench), stone+wood->stone_pickaxe (hand), iron_ingot+plank->iron_pickaxe (workbench).

Create packages/game-engine/src/crafting/craftingOps.ts with pure functions: canCraft(inventory, recipeId, station) checks ingredients and station requirement, startCraft(state, recipeId) begins timer, tickCraft(state, deltaMs) advances, completeCraft(recipeId, inventory) consumes ingredients/adds result, getToolBonus(inventory, toolType) returns harvest speed multiplier based on best tool held, getAvailableRecipes(station) filters by station type.

Create packages/game-engine/src/crafting/craftingState.ts with CraftingState interface (state: 'idle'|'crafting'|'done'|'failed', selectedRecipe: string|null, timer: number, station: CraftingStation).

Create packages/game-engine/src/components/CraftingComponent.ts with type 'crafting', fields: state (CraftingState), station (CraftingStation - what station is nearby), requestedCraft (string|null), version number.

Create packages/game-engine/src/systems/CraftingSystem.ts following the CookingSystem pattern exactly: requires ['crafting', 'inventory'], processes requestedCraft, validates station proximity, runs timer, completes craft. Resets terminal states after one frame.

Integrate tool bonuses into HarvestSystem: read the player's inventory to check for axes (wood harvesting speed) and pickaxes (stone/ore harvesting speed). Add a getToolMultiplier helper that the HarvestSystem calls to scale energy cost or yield.

Add crafting i18n keys to all 12 locale files: crafting.title, crafting.station.hand, crafting.station.workbench, crafting.start, crafting.inProgress, crafting.done, crafting.failed, crafting.needStation, recipe names for all 8+ recipes, item names for new items.

Add new achievements: 'first_craft' (condition: {kind: 'craft', count: 1}), 'tool_master' (condition: {kind: 'craft', count: 5}). Add 'craft' condition kind to AchievementCondition union and AchievementSource interface.
Export new components, system, and crafting module from packages/game-engine/src/index.ts.

Write tests in packages/game-engine/src/__tests__/crafting.test.ts covering: recipe definitions, canCraft with/without ingredients, canCraft station requirement, startCraft/tickCraft/completeCraft lifecycle, tool bonus calculation, system integration harness. At least 30 test cases.
Create apps/web/src/components/CraftingPanel.tsx showing available recipes filtered by current station, ingredient requirements, craft button, progress bar. Wire into GameUI.tsx with 'C' keybinding.
acceptance_criteria: pnpm build passes with crafting module compiled
pnpm test passes with at least 30 new crafting tests
pnpm lint passes with no new warnings
All 12 locale files have new crafting i18n keys
8+ new items in the item catalogue
Tool bonuses integrated into harvest system
